caption: The drawing depicts an ornate chair with a high, decorative backrest and a cushioned seat. The chair’s frame appears to be predominantly black with intricate gold detailing, including floral motifs and scrollwork on both the legs and back. The top of the backrest features a detailed carving incorporating a human face or bust, flanked by golden elements and finials. The chair’s seat is upholstered in a rich, deep magenta or purple fabric with a patterned texture. The drawing is centered on a plain, light-colored background with no additional elements. Below the chair, handwritten text provides identification and information, reading: "WINDOW CHAIR—1850 FEB 6 1936 APPROXIMATE SIZE," "HENRY BLANKENFELD CITY MUSEUM OF N.Y.," and "21'' X 20'' BACK 3' 11''."
title: Window Chair (one of a pair)
